brief:
Radea released a statement addressing what it described as the intentions of collaborationist gangs accused of killing dozens of Bedouins in northern Gaza, according to Shehab Wire. The organization characterized the violence as part of a broader pattern targeting civilian populations in the region.

The statement emerged amid reports of escalating violence affecting Bedouin communities in northern Gaza during the ongoing conflict. Radea did not provide specific details about the number of casualties, the identities of those responsible, or the circumstances surrounding the killings in its public statement.
